'''Reactor Crucible''' is an [[AIC]] [[Facilities|facility]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Item description|A facility for running solid or liquid-state chemical reactions.|After multiple incidents of reactor failures caused by material fatigue and corrosion, Endfield finally decided to approach UWST and purchase a batch of special steel from southern Talos-II.}}

A facility for running solid or liquid-state chemical reactions.
